blocks.text: `std.csv` (RFC 4180) reads fields correctly with the quoting and separator rules: `csv.parse(text, ',')` gives a `Result[List[List[string]], string]`. `csv.format_row` writes a row, quoting where needed.

`std.uuid` makes RFC 9562 identifiers: `v4` random, `v7` time-ordered, `v5` name-based (the same name always gives the same id). `std.log` writes levelled lines to stderr (`log.info`, `log.warn`, `log.kv`) and gives JSON output with `log.set_json(true)`.

blocks.prompt: Read the text `"a,b\nc,d\n"` with `csv.parse` and print the number of rows.

blocks.q: Which version always produces the same UUID for the same name?
blocks.why: `v5` is computed from a name and a namespace; `v4` is random, `v7` depends on time.
